name: SMC Global Securities Ltd
title: SMC Global Securities Ltd - 543263 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue +22.6% YoY and EBITDA margin 17.4% (+250bp) on broking and insurance leverage, but FY26 EBITDA fell 10.3% and PAT 29.9% as NBFC AUM shrank to INR 1,119 crore and finance costs rose to INR 221.3 crore.

triggers.label: NBFC AUM growth 15-20% guided
triggers.quote: AUM, we expect to grow at around 15% to 20% during the year.

triggers.label: Q4 broking segment EBIT +66.6% YoY
triggers.quote: segment EBIT improving sharply by 66.6% YoY to INR 60.9 crore in the quarter

triggers.label: RBI curb on NBFC leverage for propriety trading
triggers.quote: the RBI circular restricting leverage for NB FC and group entitie s in propriety trading

guidance.quote: AUM, we expect to grow at around 15% to 20% during the year.
we expect basically a 15% growth over the next financial year as well
we expect it to go above INR 800 crores

red_flags.label: NBFC AUM shrinking, disbursements collapsed
red_flags.quote: NBFC AUMs stood at INR 1,119 crore as of March 2026, down from INR 1,291 crore a year ago

red_flags.label: Large secured GNPA slow to recover
red_flags.quote: the legal process or the settlement process is taking some time

red_flags.label: Consolidated D/E 1.53x and finance costs up
red_flags.quote: higher consolidated finance costs of INR 221.3 crores

evasions.topic: Propriety trading impact under RBI leverage curb
evasions.quote: So, there would be minimal impact or rather very negligible impact or maybe no impact on our operations.
